Platform.title: Platform
Platform.description: An Arabic digital platform or product to be advertised and reviewed.

url.description: The URL link to the platform.

description.description: Description in the format: brief overview - latest improvement - version

category.description: The category of the platform (e.g., Education, Tech, AI, Commerce).

imageUrl.description: The image asset or advertising visual URL.

ownerId.description: The UID of the creator who registered the platform.

ownerName.description: The display name of the creator.

Upvote.title: Upvote
Upvote.description: An upvote document indicating that a user liked a platform.

Advice.title: Advice
Advice.description: Constructive user feedback and advice on improving the platform.

content.description: The feedback message text in Arabic.

HeuristicRating.title: HeuristicRating
HeuristicRating.description: A user's specific rating across the 10 Jacob Nielsen usability heuristics.

/platforms/{platformId}.description: The collection of advertised Arabic platforms.

/platforms/{platformId}/upvotes/{userId}.description: Subcollection storing users who upvoted the platform to prevent double voting.

/platforms/{platformId}/advices/{adviceI.description: Subcollection under each platform storing constructive user advice.

/platforms/{platformId}/heuristic_rating.description: Subcollection under each platform storing 10 usability ratings by various users.
